input.title: feat: recover source actor movement rules
input.body:
## Summary

```text
actor pose + movement state + projected point + RNG
  → translate with prior rotation / force
  → store twip coordinates
  → advance or plan turn
  → damp whole force vector
```

Recover the permanent movement module from original `928a5c6`: radial safety turns, holds, pursuit, stationary/boss branches, setup and source quirks. World wiring follows with the remaining behavior controllers; the live AI and Phasing clock continue to own their current paths.

The module preserves `_‑KM` arithmetic order and uses the existing display-value setter. The reference [DisplayObject wrappers](https://github.com/ruffle-rs/ruffle/blob/v0.7.1/core/src/avm2/globals/flash/display/display_object.rs#L288-L344) corroborate per-assignment twip conversion. This corrects the old checkpoint's unrounded coordinate expectation.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The source-checkpoint candidate returns unrounded 2.08 / 0.08; the stored-coordinate regression fails.
  **After:** It stores 2.05 / 0.05, translates before the prior turn, and damps by whole-vector length.
- Eleven cases cover safety delay/radial wrap, descending rolls, fractional/negative Skittish counters, strict post-move pursuit, Wall Flower bypass, stationary/ally differences, boss sequencing, signed opposite ties, scale/sticky bounds and source Infinity/NaN planning state.
- ActionScript and six pcode method audits confirm ordering and `_‑OJ`'s GetLength property-read quirk. Source constructor/Setup RNG interleaving, matrix-side non-finite behavior and synchronized Adobe/game parity remain unfinished.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 616 tests / 6,812 assertions and production build pass. No browser flow calls this new module yet; live movement/controller integration remains required.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way

New module and state type; no stored-data migration.

**Blast Radius:** Simulation

Establishes the source movement API for subsequent World/controller integration.
